title: Dian S Probable NDE 377
content: I'm in a very, very dark place (frighteningly dark), but I know to look for a light, and I find one off in the distance. The light becomes a tunnel head (opening); a force pulls me into the tunnel and pulls me very rapidly through a bluish-green tunnel. I'm thinking, 'Why am I back here. What have I done wrong?' I'm slammed up against the end of the tunnel, and cannot get a breath; simultaneously my life is flowing in front of my face, no matter how I turn to get away from it. Willing to shake hands with The Devil for a breath, I realize I'm going to have to do something about this life I'm confronting. My feeling is I'm being tortured because I can't breathe and I finally have a realization that I have to do something with this life. It dawns on me I will forgive myself for not doing it perfectly, and I say this aloud to myself. Upon saying this, the wall disappears and I'm in a warm beautiful 'really neat' place. The first thing I thought was, 'They lied to me; there's nothing to judge here with.' (Read that carefully.) The experience of being there was 'Like swimming naked at night in the Gulf of Mexico' totally supported, perfect environment. The next realization was that my body was not there, but I had a sense of where it should be. Next, I knew everything; I had all knowledge. There was also the realization that the past was around me, the future was around me but everything was Now. I was not the Now-ness, but I was a part of that Now-ness, and it could not be without me, and I could not be without it. I began to be moved again and I wondered where I'm going, but I stop. I look around, and look below and see I'm over the University of Texas at Austin. While attending University of Texas I never bothered to find out what the quote carved into the administration building meant. Between classes you read, 'Ye shall know the truth and the truth shall set you free.' Every day I would read this and wonder what that meant, but I was into beer and football not truth. Voices speak; they are in my thoughts; they ask do you know what that means now? Before I could say no, bodies were stepping out of graves in the plaza in front of the administration building where I would pass to go to class. As I surmise I say 'Yes, it means you have to die to be born,' but I realize this will not affect me as I'm already dead. However, the voices say 'Now that you know, you have to go back.' I said (furiously) 'I want to talk to the Boss!

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Over the University of Texas at Austin (viewing the administration building/plaza from above).

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Pulled very rapidly through a bluish-green tunnel; 'slammed up against the end of the tunnel' and could not breathe.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'warm beautiful' place; described as 'Like swimming naked at night in the Gulf of Mexico'—totally supported, perfect environment.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Voices: 'Now that you know, you have to go back.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied requirement to return after gaining understanding ('Now that you know, you have to go back.').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vision of bodies stepping out of graves at UT Austin while voices questioned the meaning of the carved quote.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness → light/tunnel → forced rapid transit → barrier/no breath with life flowing before face → self-forgiveness → warm beautiful place with 'all knowledge'/Now-ness → movement stops → viewing UT Austin from above → voices instruct return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: At the tunnel end: inability to breathe occurred simultaneously with the life 'flowing in front of my face.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Interpretive scene at the University of Texas at Austin (quote on administration building; bodies stepping out of graves) accompanied by voices asking if the experiencer now understands the quote.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I'm in a very, very dark place (frighteningly dark)"; "The light becomes a tunnel head (opening); a force pulls me into the tunnel"; "I'm slammed up against the end of the tunnel, and cannot get a breath"; "simultaneously my life is flowing in front of my face"; "I will forgive myself for not doing it perfectly"; "the wall disappears and I'm in a warm beautiful 'really neat' place"; "Like swimming naked at night in the Gulf of Mexico"; "Next, I knew everything; I had all knowledge"; "the past was around me, the future was around me but everything was Now"; "Ye shall know the truth and the truth shall set you free"; "Now that you know, you have to go back."; "I want to talk to the Boss!"
